scheme_name: State Reward to the Recipient of National Award
description:
The State Reward to the Recipient of National Award is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched to recognize and reward individuals who have received national awards for their outstanding contributions in various fields. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and recognition to these awardees. 

It was established to encourage excellence and motivate individuals to contribute positively to society. 

The scheme is particularly focused on those who have received prestigious awards such as the Padma Awards, which include Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri. 

The Padma Awards are conferred annually on Republic Day. 

The recipients of these awards are selected based on their exceptional achievements in fields such as art, literature, education, sports, and social work. 

The primary objective of the State Reward to the Recipient of National Award scheme is to honor these individuals. 

The scheme also aims to promote a culture of appreciation for excellence in various domains. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme varies based on the award received. 

For instance, recipients of the Padma Vibhushan award receive a one-time cash reward of INR 10 lakh. 

Recipients of the Padma Bhushan award receive a one-time cash reward of INR 7.5 lakh. 

Recipients of the Padma Shri award receive a one-time cash reward of INR 5 lakh. 

In addition to the cash rewards, the scheme also includes a certificate of appreciation. 

This certificate serves as a formal recognition of the recipient's achievements. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are straightforward. 

Only individuals who have received a national award are eligible for the benefits under this scheme. 

There are no specific age limits or income criteria for eligibility. 

However, the individual must be a citizen of India. 

The application process for the State Reward to the Recipient of National Award is relatively simple. 

The awardees do not need to apply separately for this scheme. 

The awards are conferred by the Government of India, and the financial assistance is automatically processed. 

The required documents for the disbursement of funds typically include proof of identity and a copy of the award certificate. 

These documents are usually verified by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for the disbursement of funds is generally aligned with the announcement of the national awards. 

The awards are announced on January 25 each year. 

The financial rewards are typically disbursed shortly after the awards ceremony, which takes place on January 26. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Home Affairs. 

The Ministry of Home Affairs is responsible for the overall administration of the Padma Awards. 

For any inquiries related to the scheme, individuals can contact the Ministry of Home Affairs. 

The contact details for the Ministry of Home Affairs are available on their official website. 

The scheme has been instrumental in motivating individuals to excel in their respective fields. 

It has also helped in creating awareness about the contributions of various individuals to society. 

The financial rewards serve as a token of appreciation for the hard work and dedication of the awardees. 

The scheme has seen a steady increase in the number of recipients over the years. 

For instance, in 2021, a total of 119 Padma Awards were conferred. 

This included 7 Padma Vibhushan awards, 10 Padma Bhushan awards, and 102 Padma Shri awards. 

The recognition provided through this scheme has encouraged many individuals to strive for excellence. 

It has also fostered a sense of pride among the awardees and their communities. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in promoting the arts, culture, and social work in India. 

It highlights the importance of recognizing and rewarding exceptional contributions to society. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is significant for many awardees. 

It can help them continue their work and contribute further to their fields. 

The scheme also serves to inspire future generations to pursue excellence. 

It emphasizes the value of hard work and dedication in achieving success.
